notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.42 wheel; GPT-6 Luna (low reasoning) through the OpenAI Responses API with an API key, flex service tier. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. Two infrastructure failures (connection errors creating the sandbox) were rerun as replacements; the originals are kept as evidence.

Ran 1–3 October, after the flex serving anomaly bench-run recorded on 30 September–1 October (a faster serving path with lower task success, which wrote off three TB4 cohorts); no trial of this run falls in that window.

Cost is Harbor's recorded cost at the cohort's configured OpenAI flex rates (card-packs pricing catalog 2026-09-29.1, rules gpt-6-luna-flex-short / -long: $0.05 / $0.005 / $0.25 per million input / cached / output tokens; $0.10 / $0.01 / $0.375 above 272k context). Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
